decisions.proposed_text: Không dùng được ở màn hình này
decisions.reason: The current wording is unnecessarily wide; 'màn hình này' preserves the current-screen restriction more compactly.

decisions.proposed_text: Có phím chưa đặt làm phím chính
decisions.reason: Removing the passive helper wording keeps the unset-primary-key warning and reduces width.

decisions.proposed_text: Luôn hiện hiệu ứng lựa chọn
decisions.reason: The shorter setting label preserves the always-show option-effect behavior without the wider 'hiển thị' form.

decisions.proposed_text: Không dùng khi toàn màn hình
decisions.reason: The mode restriction is clear without 'chế độ'; this is substantially narrower and keeps the full-screen limitation.

decisions.proposed_text:
Bật điều khiển bàn phím
để thiết lập
decisions.reason: The compact condition-action form preserves the required keyboard-control setting and the source newline count.

decisions.proposed_text:
Khi xem đua màn hình ngang
phát cắt cảnh kỹ năng
decisions.reason: The current two-line setting is verbose; this keeps the landscape-race condition, established skill cut-in wording, and exactly one newline.

decisions.proposed_text: Dừng máy chọn nhạc bên phải
decisions.reason: The polite helper is unnecessary in a compact instruction; the right-side jukebox action remains explicit.

decisions.proposed_text: Không dùng máy chọn nhạc khi Live
decisions.reason: Using the compact 'khi Live' construction preserves the Live restriction while reducing width.

decisions.proposed_text: Dừng máy chọn nhạc bên trái
decisions.reason: The polite helper is unnecessary in a compact instruction; the left-side jukebox action remains explicit.

decisions.proposed_text: Đã ghim cửa sổ trò chơi
decisions.reason: In the window-management context, 'ghim' already conveys always-on-top; the current explanatory tail is redundant.

decisions.proposed_text: Đã bỏ ghim cửa sổ trò chơi
decisions.reason: The compact completion status preserves cancellation of always-on-top without the redundant 'khỏi trên cùng' phrase.

decisions.proposed_text: Có truyện để xem liên tiếp
decisions.reason: The current sentence repeats 'có'; the compact notification preserves availability of consecutively viewable stories.

decisions.proposed_text: Có thể đổi trong <color=#ff9900>Tùy chọn</color>
decisions.reason: The current notice is extremely wide; the shorter form preserves that this can be changed in Options and keeps the color markup exactly.

decisions.proposed_text: Trạng thái <color=#2E85E6>「{0}」</color> <color=#FF6D26>đã khỏi</color>
decisions.reason: The compact recovery status keeps the placeholder and both color tags exactly while removing the verbose passive construction.

decisions.proposed_text: Cuộc đua mục tiêu: <color=#ff5f8d>{0}</color>
decisions.reason: A label-style construction preserves the target-race assignment and placeholder while removing the wide passive wording.

decisions.proposed_text: <color=#ff9900>Truyện hiện có</color> đến đây
decisions.reason: The compact wording preserves the boundary of currently available stories and keeps the source color tag exactly.

decisions.proposed_text: Đủ điều kiện sẽ mở khóa truyện
decisions.reason: The condition-result relationship is clear without the verbose 'sau khi đáp ứng' construction.

decisions.proposed_text: {0} mở khóa: top {1}
decisions.reason: The compact unlock-condition label preserves both placeholders and the required top-{1} placement.

decisions.proposed_text: Kỹ năng <color=#FF911C>chỉ dùng khi đua</color>
decisions.reason: The introductory 'Đây là' and full race noun are unnecessary; the compact form preserves the race-only restriction and markup.

decisions.proposed_text: <color=#ff9900>Cốt truyện chính phần {0}</color> kết thúc
decisions.reason: The current ending notice is unnecessarily wide; the shorter form preserves the main-story part, placeholder, and color markup exactly.
